isIndemnityInsurance.description: Indicates whether the coverage group is indemnity insurance instead of sum insured.

isFullCoverage.description: Indicates whether the KTG cover is full coverage instead of coordination coverage.

dailyAllowanceInsured.description: Indicates whether daily allowance coverage is insured.

maximumBenefitPeriodInDays.description: Maximum benefit period without deduction of the waiting period; normally 720 or 730.

dailyAllowanceStages.description: Configured daily allowance stages in chronological order. Single entry if daily allowance is not staggered. Up to 3 entries if staggered, for first, second and third daily allowance.
